_purpose: Predefined, bounded PAPER_AUTONOMOUS risk policy. The bot executes eligible strategies WITHOUT per-trade or per-coin manual approval, but every entry/exit is validated against these hard limits by the independent risk layer (app/risk/policy.py + PaperAutonomous.confirm_trade_entry). This is autonomous execution inside a policy, not unrestricted trading. PAPER ONLY.
revised: 2026-10-22 rev4 (MULTI-ASSET expansion, owner-approved plan): structural max_total_open_exposure_usd raised 55->105 = the sum of per-pair max stakes across the now-three disjoint executors (BTC 15 + fast 6x10 + swing 3x10); max_total_exposure_pct_equity stays 0.40 so the RUNTIME cap on a $100 account is min(105, 40) = $40 and still binds hard; a THIRD 'swing' executor (1h, LTC/AVAX/DOGE) added; fast max_open_trades reduced 3->2 so summed max_open_trades (daily 1 + fast 2 + swing 1 = 4) <= max_concurrent_positions 4

authorization.paper_autonomous: APPROVED_BY_OWNER (directive 2026-10-21, CONSERVATIVE $100 preset): automatic BUY/SELL/HOLD/EXIT for eligible crypto in Alpaca PAPER without per-trade approval, sized for a $100 balance. Only the DAILY BTC executor is started first; the fast 5m alt executor stays configured but is not run until the $100 path is verified.

per_position.sizing: Quantity derived from the actual stop distance where applicable; stake is reduced further if the stop distance would breach max_planned_loss_usd.

portfolio.exposure_rule: effective cap = min(max_total_open_exposure_usd, max_total_exposure_pct_equity * current_paper_equity). On a $100 account this is min(105, 40) = $40 total open exposure; the $105 STRUCTURAL ceiling only lets validate_executors pass the worst-case whitelist sum (BTC 15 + fast 6x10 + swing 3x10 = 105). At $100 the 40%-equity rule always binds first, so breadth of pairs adds learning surface, NOT more simultaneous dollars at risk.
portfolio.reported_buying_power_note: On the $100 paper account buying_power is ~$100. It is NOT the bound: the independent $40 (min of $105 fixed / 40%-equity) exposure cap is the real limit.

circuit_breakers.disclaimer: A loss limit does not guarantee an exact maximum loss; slippage, gaps, API failures and execution latency can produce worse results.

executors.note: Three DISJOINT PAPER order executors are CONFIGURED (multi-asset expansion, owner-approved plan 2026-10-22). 'daily' = BTC baseline only (1d Z-score, stake 15, max 1). 'fast' = LIVE-STRICT alts ETH/XRP/DOT/LINK/SOL/UNI (5m dispatcher, 10 each, max 2 open). 'swing' = PAPER-RELAXED wide-spread names LTC/AVAX/DOGE (1h cost-aware dispatcher, 10 each, max 1 open); its eligibility gate is relaxed per the owner-approved plan (spread > 0.5% / thin) but the cost-aware -6% stop sits well beyond the ~1.1% round-trip cost. Each Freqtrade process only sees its own trade DB, so the read-only monitor writes app/state/open_exposure.json (aggregating ALL THREE) and every confirm_trade_entry adds the OTHER executors' open stake before the exposure-cap check (fail-closed if the ledger is stale) — the $40 (min of $105 / 40%-equity) cap stays global, not per-process. Pair sets are disjoint. Structural worst case = BTC 15 + fast 6x10 + swing 3x10 = 105 <= fixed cap 105; positions 1 + 2 + 1 = 4 <= max_concurrent 4; runtime open exposure additionally bounded to ~$40 by the 40%-equity rule. NOTE: BTC stake is 15 (not 10) because Alpaca enforces a ~$15 minimum order notional on BTC/USD; alt/swing stakes are 10 (all fractionable with tiny base minimums). Only the daily executor is STARTED first; fast and swing stay configured but running=false until the $100 daily path is verified.

fail_closed: Stale or unavailable market data / equity snapshot.
An unresolved order or open position already exists for the pair.
Any portfolio or per-position limit would be breached.
configurability: All amounts and percentages above are the source of truth and are validated at startup by app/scripts/preflight.py. Changing any limit requires a new owner-approved revision.
